core_claim: Treated as two corpora, the headline framings invert: Beyoncé says 'love' more per word than Taylor, and Taylor's eight-album sentiment line stays positive until folklore.

edt_01.label: Hook — Two corpora, one comparison
edt_01.editorial_notes: Open with the dataset and the 2009 VMAs link; embed Single Ladies (inst_02) as the bridge between the two artists.

edt_02.label: The lyric-size gap is structural
edt_02.title: The 3.3x lyric gap is built into the dataset
edt_02.editorial_notes: Lemonade Film (Script) at 336 lines and 'Get Me Bodied' live versions must be visible — they're the proof that this isn't an artistic gap.

edt_03.label: 48 chants vs 12 hooks
edt_03.title: 48 chants vs 12 hooks
edt_03.editorial_notes: 48 and 12 are the central numbers — they must appear in the prose AND be visually highlighted.

edt_04.label: Beyoncé says love more
edt_04.title: Beyoncé says "love" more than Taylor does
edt_04.editorial_notes: ana_06 (1.5x ratio) is the LEAD finding of the whole piece. Embed Halo (inst_01) as the listening evidence.

edt_05.label: Distinctive vocabularies
edt_05.title: Bodies and rooms vs landscapes and daylight
edt_05.editorial_notes: Make the asymmetry between Beyoncé-leaning and Taylor-leaning words visible at a glance.

edt_06.label: Folklore the only sad album
edt_06.title: Folklore is the only sad Taylor album
edt_06.editorial_notes: −0.21 must be exact and the only net-negative album. Show all 8 albums in order; let the reader feel the line cross zero.

edt_07.label: Different markets, different #1s
edt_07.title: Different markets, different #1s
edt_07.editorial_notes: 100%, 87.5%, 75%, 87.5% are the country-by-country % numbers — show all 10 countries.

edt_08.label: Per-album sales nearly identical
edt_08.title: Per album, the sales gap nearly disappears
edt_08.editorial_notes: 6.80M vs 6.90M is the headline; show all reported worldwide albums together so the proximity is visible.

edt_09.label: Close — what the corpus says back
edt_09.editorial_notes: BVE caveat goes here. Don't summarise; close on the asymmetry.
